versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ יְרַחֵ֨ם יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֗ב וּבָחַ֥ר עוֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם עַל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְנִלְוָ֤ה הַגֵּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
controles.kjv: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR terá piedade de Jacó, e ainda escolherá a Israel, e os porá em sua terra; e estrangeiros se juntarão a eles, e se apegarão à casa de Jacó.

versos.hebraico: וּלְקָח֣וּם עַמִּים֮ וֶהֱבִיא֣וּם אֶל־מְקוֹמָם֒ וְהִֽתְנַחֲל֣וּם בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְלִשְׁפָח֑וֹת וְהָיוּ֙ שֹׁבִ֣ים לְשֹֽׁבֵיהֶ֔ם וְרָד֖וּ בְּנֹגְשֵׂיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
controles.kjv: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
controles.livre: E os povos os receberão, e os levarão a seus lugares, e a casa de Israel terá posse deles como servos e servas, na terra do SENHOR; e capturarão aos que tinham lhes capturado, e dominarão sobre seus opressores.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם הָנִ֤יחַ יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ מֵֽעָצְבְּךָ֖ וּמֵרָגְזֶ֑ךָ וּמִן־הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַקָּשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֻבַּד־בָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
controles.livre: E será que, no dia em que o SENHOR te der descanso de teu trabalho e de teu tormento, e da dura escravidão que te escravizaram,

versos.hebraico: וְנָשָׂ֜אתָ הַמָּשָׁ֥ל הַזֶּ֛ה עַל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאָמָ֑רְתָּ אֵ֚יךְ שָׁבַ֣ת נֹגֵ֔שׂ שָׁבְתָ֖ה מַדְהֵבָֽה׃

controles.web: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
controles.kjv: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
controles.livre: Então levantarás estas palavras de escárnio contra o rei da Babilônia, e dirás: Vede como foi o fim do opressor, como a cidade dourada se acabou!

versos.hebraico: שָׁבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה מַטֵּ֣ה רְשָׁעִ֑ים שֵׁ֖בֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים׃

controles.web: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
controles.kjv: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
controles.livre: O SENHOR quebrou o bastão dos perversos, o cetro dos que dominavam,

versos.hebraico: מַכֶּ֤ה עַמִּים֙ בְּעֶבְרָ֔ה מַכַּ֖ת בִּלְתִּ֣י סָרָ֑ה רֹדֶ֤ה בָאַף֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם מֻרְדָּ֖ף בְּלִ֥י חָשָֽׂךְ׃

controles.web: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
controles.kjv: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
controles.livre: Que feria aos povos com furor com golpes sem fim, que com ira dominava as nações, perseguindo sem compaixão.

versos.hebraico: נָ֥חָה שָׁקְטָ֖ה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פָּצְח֖וּ רִנָּֽה׃

controles.web: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out song.
controles.kjv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
controles.livre: A terra descansa, já está sossegada; gritam de prazer com alegria.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־בְּרוֹשִׁ֛ים שָׂמְח֥וּ לְךָ֖ אַרְזֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן מֵאָ֣ז שָׁכַ֔בְתָּ לֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֥ה הַכֹּרֵ֖ת עָלֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: Yes, the fir trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
controles.kjv: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
controles.livre: Até os pinheiros se alegram por causa de ti, e os cedros do Líbano, dizendo: Desde que tu caíste, ninguém mais sobe contra nós, para nos cortar.

versos.hebraico: שְׁא֗וֹל מִתַּ֛חַת רָגְזָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לִקְרַ֣את בּוֹאֶ֑ךָ עוֹרֵ֨ר לְךָ֤ רְפָאִים֙ כָּל־עַתּ֣וּדֵי אָ֔רֶץ הֵקִים֙ מִכִּסְאוֹתָ֔ם כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
controles.kjv: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
controles.livre: O mundo dos mortos desde suas profundezas se agitou por causa de ti, para sair ao teu encontro em tua chegada; por causa de ti ele despertou aos mortos, todos os líderes da terra, e fez levantar de seus tronos a todos os reis das nações.

versos.hebraico: כֻּלָּ֣ם יַֽעֲנ֔וּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ גַּם־אַתָּ֛ה חֻלֵּ֥יתָ כָמ֖וֹנוּ אֵלֵ֥ינוּ נִמְשָֽׁלְתָּ׃

controles.web: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
controles.kjv: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
controles.livre: Eles todos responderão e te dirão: Tu enfraqueceste tal como nós, e te tornaste semelhante a nós.

versos.hebraico: הוּרַ֥ד שְׁא֛וֹל גְּאוֹנֶ֖ךָ הֶמְיַ֣ת נְבָלֶ֑יךָ תַּחְתֶּ֨יךָ֙ יֻצַּ֣ע רִמָּ֔ה וּמְכַסֶּ֖יךָ תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃

controles.web: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
controles.kjv: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
controles.livre: Tua soberba foi derrubada ao mundo dos mortos, assim como o som de tuas harpas; larvas se espalharão por debaixo de ti, e vermes te cobrirão.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛יךְ נָפַ֥לְתָּ מִשָּׁמַ֖יִם הֵילֵ֣ל בֶּן־שָׁ֑חַר נִגְדַּ֣עְתָּ לָאָ֔רֶץ חוֹלֵ֖שׁ עַל־גּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
controles.kjv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
controles.livre: Como caíste do céu, ó “luminoso”, filho do amanhecer! Cortado foste até a terra, tu que enfraquecias as nações!

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ בִֽלְבָבְךָ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֶֽעֱלֶ֔ה מִמַּ֥עַל לְכֽוֹכְבֵי־אֵ֖ל אָרִ֣ים כִּסְאִ֑י וְאֵשֵׁ֥ב בְּהַר־מוֹעֵ֖ד בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפֽוֹן׃

controles.web: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
controles.kjv: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
controles.livre: E tu dizias em teu coração: Subirei ao céu; levantarei o meu trono acima das estrelas de Deus, e me sentarei no monte da congregação, nas regiões distantes do norte.

versos.hebraico: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל־בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃

controles.web: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
controles.kjv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
controles.livre: Subirei sobre as alturas das nuvens, e serei semelhante ao Altíssimo!

versos.hebraico: אַ֧ךְ אֶל־שְׁא֛וֹל תּוּרָ֖ד אֶל־יַרְכְּתֵי־בֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
controles.kjv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
controles.livre: Porém tu serás derrubado ao mundo dos mortos, às profundezas da cova.

versos.hebraico: רֹאֶ֨יךָ֙ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יַשְׁגִּ֔יחוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ יִתְבּוֹנָ֑נוּ הֲזֶ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ מַרְגִּ֣יז הָאָ֔רֶץ מַרְעִ֖ישׁ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms;
controles.kjv: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
controles.livre: Os que te olharem prestarão atenção em ti, pensarão, e dirão : É este o homem que abalava a terra, e fazia os reinos tremerem?

versos.hebraico: שָׂ֥ם תֵּבֵ֛ל כַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְעָרָ֣יו הָרָ֑ס אֲסִירָ֖יו לֹא־פָ֥תַח בָּֽיְתָה׃

controles.web: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities; who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
controles.kjv: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
controles.livre: Que fazia do mundo como um deserto, e arruinava suas cidades? Que nunca soltava seus prisioneiros para suas casas?

versos.hebraico: כָּל־מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם שָׁכְב֥וּ בְכָב֖וֹד אִ֥ישׁ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
controles.kjv: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
controles.livre: Todos os reis das nações, eles todos, jazem com honra, cada um em sua própria casa.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָשְׁלַ֤כְתָּ מִֽקִּבְרְךָ֙ כְּנֵ֣צֶר נִתְעָ֔ב לְב֥וּשׁ הֲרֻגִ֖ים מְטֹ֣עֲנֵי חָ֑רֶב יוֹרְדֵ֥י אֶל־אַבְנֵי־ב֖וֹר כְּפֶ֥גֶר מוּבָֽס׃

controles.web: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
controles.kjv: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
controles.livre: Porém tu és lançado de tua sepultura, como um ramo repugnante, como as roupas dos que foram mortos, traspassados à espada; como os que descem às pedras da cova, como um corpo pisoteado.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תֵחַ֤ד אִתָּם֙ בִּקְבוּרָ֔ה כִּֽי־אַרְצְךָ֥ שִׁחַ֖תָּ עַמְּךָ֣ הָרָ֑גְתָּ לֹֽא־יִקָּרֵ֥א לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֶ֥רַע מְרֵעִֽים׃

controles.web: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of evildoers will not be named forever.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
controles.livre: Não se juntará a eles na sepultura, porque destruíste tua terra, e mataste a teu povo; a semente dos malignos não será nomeada para sempre.

versos.hebraico: הָכִ֧ינוּ לְבָנָ֛יו מַטְבֵּ֖חַ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתָ֑ם בַּל־יָקֻ֨מוּ֙ וְיָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵֽי־תֵבֵ֖ל עָרִֽים׃

controles.web: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
controles.kjv: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
controles.livre: Preparai a matança para seus filhos por causa da maldade de seus pais; para que não se levantem, e tomem posse da terra, e encham a face do mundo de cidades.

versos.hebraico: וְקַמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל שֵׁ֥ם וּשְׁאָ֛ר וְנִ֥ין וָנֶ֖כֶד נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Porque me levantarei contra eles,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos; e cortarei para eliminar da Babilônia o nome e os restantes, o filho e o neto, diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתִּ֛יהָ לְמוֹרַ֥שׁ קִפֹּ֖ד וְאַגְמֵי־מָ֑יִם וְטֵֽאטֵאתִ֨יהָ֙ בְּמַטְאֲטֵ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֔ד נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: E eu a porei como propriedade de corujas, e poças d´água; e a varrerei com a vassoura da destruição,diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־לֹ֞א כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּמִּ֨יתִי֙ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֔תָה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָעַ֖צְתִּי הִ֥יא תָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
controles.kjv: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
controles.livre: O SENHOR dos exércitos jurou, dizendo: Com certeza acontecerá assim como pensei, e será comprido assim como determinei.

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁבֹּ֤ר אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּאַרְצִ֔י וְעַל־הָרַ֖י אֲבוּסֶ֑נּוּ וְסָ֤ר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ עֻלּ֔וֹ וְסֻ֨בֳּל֔וֹ מֵעַ֥ל שִׁכְמ֖וֹ יָסֽוּר׃

controles.web: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
controles.kjv: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
controles.livre: Quebrarei a Assíria em minha terra, e em minhas montanhas eu a esmagarei; para que seu jugo se afaste deles, e sua carga seja tirada de seus ombros.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֛את הָעֵצָ֥ה הַיְּעוּצָ֖ה עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזֹ֛את הַיָּ֥ד הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה עַל־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
controles.kjv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
controles.livre: Este é o plano determinado para toda a terra; e esta é a mão que está estendida sobre todas as nações.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יָעָ֖ץ וּמִ֣י יָפֵ֑ר וְיָד֥וֹ הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה וּֽמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃פ

controles.web: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
controles.kjv: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
controles.livre: Pois o SENHOR dos exércitos já determinou; quem invalidará? E sua mão já está estendida; quem a retrocederá?

versos.hebraico: בִּשְׁנַת־מ֖וֹת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֑ז הָיָ֖ה הַמַּשָּׂ֥א הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.
controles.kjv: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
controles.livre: No ano em que o rei Acaz morreu, houve esta revelação:

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י פְלֶ֨שֶׁת֙ כֻּלֵּ֔ךְ כִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַכֵּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־מִשֹּׁ֤רֶשׁ נָחָשׁ֙ יֵ֣צֵא צֶ֔פַע וּפִרְי֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ף מְעוֹפֵֽף׃

controles.web: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
controles.kjv: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
controles.livre: Não te alegres, ó tu, Filisteia inteira, por ter sido quebrada a vara que te feria; porque da raiz da cobra sairá uma víbora, e seu fruto será uma venenosa serpente voadora.

versos.hebraico: וְרָעוּ֙ בְּכוֹרֵ֣י דַלִּ֔ים וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לָבֶ֣טַח יִרְבָּ֑צוּ וְהֵמַתִּ֤י בָֽרָעָב֙ שָׁרְשֵׁ֔ךְ וּשְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖ךְ יַהֲרֹֽג׃

controles.web: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
controles.kjv: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
controles.livre: E os mais pobres  serão apascentados, e os necessitados deitarão em segurança; porém farei tua raiz morrer de fome, e ela matará teus sobreviventes.

versos.hebraico: הֵילִ֤ילִֽי שַׁ֨עַר֙ זַֽעֲקִי־עִ֔יר נָמ֖וֹג פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת כֻּלֵּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י מִצָּפוֹן֙ עָשָׁ֣ן בָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין בּוֹדֵ֖ד בְּמוֹעָדָֽיו׃

controles.web: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
controles.kjv: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
controles.livre: Uiva, ó porta! Grita, ó cidade! Tu, Filisteia inteira, estás a ser derretida; porque do norte vem fumaça, e não há solitário em seus batalhões.

versos.hebraico: וּמַֽה־יַּעֲנֶ֖ה מַלְאֲכֵי־ג֑וֹי כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִסַּ֣ד צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָ֥הּ יֶחֱס֖וּ עֲנִיֵּ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
controles.kjv: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
controles.livre: Que, pois, se responderá aos mensageiros d aquela nação? Que o SENHOR fundou a Sião, e que nela os oprimidos de seu povo terão refúgio.
